method: Device conduction is evaluated from simulated current and Rds(on). Switching overlap uses 0.5*V*I*(tr+tf) per transition. Reverse recovery is reported separately and is not included in a claimed whole-inverter efficiency.
limitations: Datasheet switching conditions are far above the approximately 2.3 Arms course-design operating point.
No nonlinear capacitance, gate-drive impedance, thermal iteration, capacitor ESR, magnetic core loss, or auxiliary loss is closed.
The default winding resistance has no material/geometry/temperature provenance; I^2R is DC-ohmic-only.
No total or whole-inverter efficiency may be claimed from these parameters alone.
